sources.what_to_extract: Orca's explanation-trace thesis: teacher emits the trace, student learns from it; the 16 hand-crafted system messages that turn GPT-4 from an answer machine into a reasoning tutor; 5M ChatGPT + 1M GPT-4 progressive-learning mix.

Strategy-level distillation over trace-only distillation: direct-answer / step-by-step / explain-then-answer / recall-then-answer / extract-then-answer; 'Prompt Erasing' trick so the student learns to select a strategy unprompted.
Hsieh 2023: joint (label + rationale) multi-task training; T5-770M beats PaLM-540B few-shot on 4 benchmarks with 80% of the data; rationale head as a regularizer on the shared encoder.
R1 report: the 800K cold-start + rejection-sampling SFT corpus (600K reasoning + 200K non-reasoning); six distilled checkpoints (1.5B–70B); pure-SFT distillation beats running RL on the student.
DeepSeek-R1 model report: explicit pipeline diagram Base→cold-start SFT→Reasoning RL→RS-SFT→Alignment RL; the distilled student recipe is pure SFT over Qwen2.5 / Llama-3 bases.
Corpus opacity: public docs give the 800K figure but not per-source breakdown; the invariant is 'keep R1 outputs that preserve reasoning pattern + answer correctness'.
17K curated pairs at ~$800 API cost; filter stack (SymPy for math / unit tests for code / GPT-4o-judge for science); reaches within 2–3 points of R1-Distill-Qwen-32B at 1/47 the data volume.
HuggingFace 220K×2-traces OpenR1-Math corpus; Math-Verify verifier (open-source SymPy); ~20% reject rate; GRPO stage on top of SFT adds +3–5 AIME points.
NovaSky $450 recipe: QwQ-32B-preview as open-weights teacher; 17K traces; GPT-4o-mini rewriter lifts AIME by +4 points; underperforms R1-distill on AIME25 because the teacher is weaker.

OpenThoughts3: 1000+ recipe ablations; QwQ-32B beats R1 as a teacher even though R1 scores higher on benchmarks; 'no filter beats no filtering' on answer side; question filters (LLM difficulty) matter more.

Open Orca-lineage reproduction showing the 'teacher-output license cliff': Apache-2.0 on the dataset does not override the underlying API's terms-of-service; why this matters for commercial redistribution.
